# Locker API

`component:locker-api` · service · python

HTTP service for deposits and collection.

> Lets couriers drop parcels off and recipients pick them up.

Evidence: [api/routes.py:6-8](../../../api/routes.py#L6-L8)

## Responsibilities

- Deposits
- Collection
